tui.help.getting_started:
Getting started

1. Accounts (3): scan the QR code with the Bilibili mobile app to sign in.
2. Room (4): set the title, category, and cover.
3. In OBS Studio's top menu, choose Tools → WebSocket Server Settings (update OBS if this option is missing) → check Enable WebSocket server → Show Connect Info → copy the server password → OK.
4. OBS (5): enter the server address (for example ws://127.0.0.1:4455) and the password you just copied.
5. On the same page, connect and enable Auto-stream. Adjust proxy and streaming protocol options in Settings (6).
6. Live (1): choose Start live. If identity verification is required, complete it and retry.

Chat history and operation logs older than seven days are automatically cleaned at startup and while running.

When Auto-stream is off, start streaming manually in OBS.
To end the broadcast, choose Stop Bilibili live on the Live page. If Auto-stream is off, also stop OBS streaming manually.

tui.obs.description:
Auto-connect: connect OBS on launch or when starting live.
Auto-stream: start/stop streaming together.
Disconnecting does not stop streaming.
OBS passwords are not stored in configuration files.
Changing the OBS URL or password disconnects the old session; reconnect afterward.
